result.title: Discovering Undisclosed Concepts in LoRA Adapters for Diffusion-Based AIGC Models
result.summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has made diffusion model personalization affordable and widely shareable, but it also creates moderation risks when harmful or problematic content is not faithfully disclosed. Hence, it is desired to develop a mechanism that, given a LoRA adapter, discovers the concept it was trained to generate, so as to support downstream investigation. We characterize the target concept through the conditioning input that most clearly exposes what the LoRA has learned. Such an input should induce coherent LoRA outputs that are distinctive from those of the base model and strongly align with the learned LoRA subspace. We therefore formulate concept discovery as searching for the conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment. Even with a clear objective, however, optimizing it over an open-ended input space is prohibitively expensive, since reliable evaluation of coherence and distinctiveness requires repeated diffusion rendering. Crucially, we observe that an input need not be rendered to determine whether it is promising. Its alignment with the learned LoRA subspace provides a lightweight signal for localizing promising candidates before visual verification. Based on this insight, we develop a two-stage framework for text-to-image LoRAs. Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES) uses render-free subspace alignment to explore candidate prompts and retain a compact shortlist, while Paired Visual Identification (PVI) renders only these candidates and compares the LoRA and base-model outputs to identify those exhibiting coherent and distinctive generation behavior. This design enables efficient and reliable discovery of previously unknown concepts encoded in LoRA adapters.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何从一个 text-to-image 扩散模型的 LoRA 适配器中反查其被训练生成的隐含概念，提出两阶段框架：先用免渲染的子空间对齐（SGES）筛选候选提示，再对少量候选渲染并与基座模型对比（PVI）以确认概念。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用低成本子空间信号先筛选候选、再有选择地付出高成本视觉核查」的结构，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、以及 THINK/LOOK 之间成本—收益权衡的问题表述有类比启发，但属生成与模型审计领域，需较多核查。
